verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own docs say you can customize the agent by specifying the LLM provider and model (v3 agent docs), so provider choice is a documented capability rather than a lock to one vendor. The evidence does not say which providers are supported, or whether act/extract/observe also accept arbitrary providers. Missing for 10: a list or breadth of supported LLM providers, evidence of bring-your-own-model configuration for act/extract/observe in v4, and independent or hands-on corroboration of model-agnostic use.
